scripts.build: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter backend typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter backend lint

pnpm.//: S-004: these overrides are NOT inherited by the deployed services. backend/ and frontend/ each build standalone with --ignore-workspace, so every security pin must be MIRRORED into backend/package.json and frontend/package.json by hand. When you add/bump a pin here for a CVE, mirror it there too (and vice-versa) or the deployed service ships unpatched. Prefer major-scoped keys (e.g. ws@7) so a security floor never becomes a version ceiling.
pnpm.//auditConfig: GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (brace-expansion OOM) publishes ONE affected range, '<=5.0.7', patched in 5.0.8. Semver-wise that range also matches the 1.x line, so pnpm audit flags brace-expansion@1.1.16 even though 1.1.16 is the newest 1.x release and already carries the fix for the separate 1.x advisory (patched >=1.1.16). The only thing pulling 1.x is eslint's minimatch@3, a devDependency: 'pnpm audit --prod' reports 0 high. Drop this entry when brace-expansion ships another 1.x release or eslint drops minimatch@3.
